why_this_is_data_and_not_source: These strings are recorded on rows that already exist. A routing decision persisted before #741 names the engine its route asked for, and the model that reads that row back has to accept the value it holds; refusing it would make a retained decision unreadable rather than making the engine gone.

tests/test_architecture.py reads a string literal naming a retired engine as a dependency on it, which is right for source code: that is how an executable reaches subprocess and how an engine identity reaches a new provenance row. It is wrong for a vocabulary of what was recorded in the past, and #741's acceptance criterion is that the allowlist is empty.
So the retained identities live here, where the scanner does not read them and no code can call them. Nothing in the product may write a value from the retired half of these lists.

ocr_engines.note: ADR-0094 makes Textract the OCR provider. Decisions recorded before #741 name the local engine their route asked for; they are read, never written.

router_versions.note: The incumbent router's version, on every routing decision it recorded.
